fields.name: visits_done
fields.description: Number of completed 'move to the top of the target' subgoals so far in the episode, counting each arrival of the held cube over a target (right or left). It is 0 at the first step and stays 0 through the step that ends the pick-up. It increases by exactly 1 at each decision step that ends a B subgoal, i.e. every decision step whose final scene shows the cube held in the gripper with a highlighted target directly below the gripper (same x region), when that target was shown as a plain, un-highlighted target in the first execution frame of the step, or when no highlighted target was shown at all in that first frame. Plain targets only early in the step and a highlighted target at the end is itself the arrival. The first such step takes it from 0 to 1. It does not change at the step that ends the put-down (cube no longer held) or at the press-button step. e.g. 3
